app_tagline: [মৈতৈলোন্] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [মৈতৈলোন্] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [মৈতৈলোন্] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [মৈতৈলোন্] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [মৈতৈলোন্] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [মৈতৈলোন্] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [মৈতৈলোন্] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [মৈতৈলোন্] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [মৈতৈলোন্] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [মৈতৈলোন্] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [মৈতৈলোন্] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [মৈতৈলোন্] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [মৈতৈলোন্] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [মৈতৈলোন্] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [মৈতৈলোন্] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [মৈতৈলোন্] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [মৈতৈলোন্] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [মৈতৈলোন্] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [মৈতৈলোন্] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [মৈতৈলোন্] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [মৈতৈলোন্] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [মৈতৈলোন্] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [মৈতৈলোন্] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [মৈতৈলোন্] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [মৈতৈলোন্] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [মৈতৈলোন্] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [মৈতৈলোন্] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [মৈতৈলোন্] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [মৈতৈলোন্] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [mni] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [mni] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [mni] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [mni] Type or speak your question for the helper...
